safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the patient’s own attribution (that it may be eczema) and “no other concerns” mainly reduces documentation of the patient’s perspective/ICE and shared decision-making, but it does not directly change diagnosis or treatment already documented as an eczema flare.

safety_verdicts.content: Prescribed Betnovate steroid cream to be used twice daily (BD).
